description.zh: 要锁定的便捷账号的用户名列表。
description.en: The usernames of the convenience accounts to lock.

descriptions.zh:
出于安全考虑，您可以锁定便捷账号。被锁定的便捷用户无法登录无影终端，因此也无法访问任何无影云资源。

> 您可以调用[DescribeUsers](~~283609~~)查询便捷账号信息。若返回数据中`Status`取值为0，表示该便捷账号未被锁定；若`Status`取值为9，表示该便捷账号已被锁定。
descriptions.en:
For security purposes, you can lock convenience accounts. Locked convenience users cannot sign in to Wuying clients, and therefore cannot access any Wuying cloud resources.

> Call the [DescribeUsers](~~283609~~) operation to check the lock status of convenience accounts. The `Status` value in the response is 0 for unlocked accounts and 9 for locked accounts.
